<ic>To appoint an imperial position: Imperial Chaplain Consular<br>
A synod virtue title (of the way) to be appointed by the Cardinal of the Way.<br><br>
Responsibilities: Advise Imperial Ambassadors on matters pertaining to the way. Provide Oversight of Imperial Ambassadors for the Synod. Study foreigners to facilitate comparative theology<br>
Powers: Once per Season, may inquisit an imperial ambassador without requiring a Judgement of the Synod. May spend up to five thrones per season from the Virtue fund.<br><br>''Proposed by Bastion, seconded by Therunin.''</ic>

===Overview===
* The [[Chaplain Consular]] can [[Inquisition|inquisit]] any Imperial Ambassador for the [[Synod]].
* They may remove up to five thrones from the [[Rewarding|virtue fund]] without requiring a judgement ... something about an announcement?

===Date===
* Spring 379YE

===Cost===
* None

===Campaign Outcome===
* The title of [[Chaplain Consular]] was created.
* Hywel Summercrow of Navarr was duly appointed to the position by the Cardinal of the Way.
